## Journal articles

::: {.pub}
<div class="pub-title">Real-Time LSTM-Driven Dynamic Gait Mode Detection for Enhanced Control of Actuated Ankle-Foot Orthosis</div>
<div class="pub-meta"><strong>Moon, H.</strong>, Bey, O., Boubezoul, A., Oukhellou, L., & Mohammed, S. (2025). <em>IEEE Transactions on Robotics</em>, 41, 4794–4809.</div>
<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://doi.org/10.1109/TRO.2025.3593111" target="_blank">[Paper]</a></div>
<details><summary>About this paper</summary>
<p>An LSTM-based gait mode detection framework that runs in real time on an
actuated ankle-foot orthosis, enabling the controller to adapt assistance
dynamically as the wearer transitions between walking conditions.</p>
</details>
:::

::: {.pub}
<div class="pub-title">Fuzzy Convolutional Attention-based GRU Network for Human Activity Recognition</div>
<div class="pub-meta">Khodabandelou, G., <strong>Moon, H.</strong>, Amirat, Y., & Mohammed, S. (2023). <em>Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence</em>, 118, 105702.</div>
<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.engappai.2022.105702" target="_blank">[Paper]</a></div>
<details><summary>About this paper</summary>
<p>A deep architecture combining fuzzy logic, convolutional attention, and
gated recurrent units to recognize human activities from wearable sensor
streams.</p>
</details>
:::

::: {.pub}
<div class="pub-title">Hybrid Half-Gaussian Selectively Adaptive Fuzzy Control of an Actuated Ankle-Foot Orthosis</div>
<div class="pub-meta"><strong>Moon, H.</strong>, Maiti, R., Das Sharma, K., Amirat, Y., Siarry, P., & Mohammed, S. (2022). <em>IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters</em>, 7, 9635–9642.</div>
<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://doi.org/10.1109/LRA.2022.3191187" target="_blank">[Paper]</a> <span class="pub-award">ICRA 2023 oral</span></div>
<details><summary>About this paper</summary>
<p>A selectively adaptive fuzzy controller with hybrid half-Gaussian membership
functions for precise, compliant assistance of ankle motion. Presented at IEEE
ICRA 2023 as an oral session.</p>
</details>
:::

::: {.pub}
<div class="pub-title">An Assistive Explicit Model Predictive Control Framework for a Knee Rehabilitation Exoskeleton</div>
<div class="pub-meta">Jammeli, I., Chemori, A., <strong>Moon, H.</strong>, Elloumi, S., & Mohammed, S. (2022). <em>IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics</em>, 27, 3636–3647.</div>
<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://doi.org/10.1109/TMECH.2021.3126674" target="_blank">[Paper]</a></div>
<details><summary>About this paper</summary>
<p>An explicit MPC framework providing assistance-as-needed for a knee
rehabilitation exoskeleton, trading online optimization for pre-computed
control laws suited to real-time embedded use.</p>
</details>
:::

::: {.pub}
<div class="pub-title">Impedance Modulation Control of a Lower-Limb Exoskeleton to Assist Sit-to-Stand Movements</div>
<div class="pub-meta">Huo, W., <strong>Moon, H.</strong>, Alouane, M. A., Bonnet, V., Huang, J., Amirat, Y., Vaidyanathan, R., & Mohammed, S. (2022). <em>IEEE Transactions on Robotics</em>, 38, 1230–1249.</div>
<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://doi.org/10.1109/TRO.2021.3104244" target="_blank">[Paper]</a></div>
<details><summary>About this paper</summary>
<p>An impedance modulation strategy that shapes exoskeleton assistance across
the phases of sit-to-stand, supporting users with reduced lower-limb strength
while preserving their voluntary contribution.</p>
</details>
:::
